description: This file defines a middleware component for ASP.NET Core that handles exceptions during HTTP request processing. It intercepts exceptions thrown in the request pipeline and returns formatted JSON error responses, standardizing error handling across the application.

classes.name: ExceptionMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that catches exceptions in the HTTP request pipeline and returns JSON error responses.

methods.name: InvokeAsync
methods.description: Main middleware method that executes the next delegate in the pipeline and handles exceptions.

methods.name: HandleExceptionAsync
methods.description: Helper method to generate and write JSON error responses based on the exception type.
